trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: State the goal and time constraint.
steps.text: Hello, मेरे पास time कम है। मुझे dermatology का appointment चाहिए next three days में।

steps.purpose: Ask for patient ID to lookup record.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent should acknowledge the request and ask for the patient ID to proceed.
steps.text: नमस्ते। मैं आपकी मदद कर देता हूँ। क्या आप अपना patient ID बता सकते हैं?
steps.planner_rationale: Before booking or checking slots, the agent needs to identify the patient and check their registration status.

steps.purpose: Provide patient ID.
steps.text: हाँ, मेरा ID है PT-1002। जल्दी कीजिए please।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge ID and inform about checking details.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent should acknowledge the patient ID and inform the user that it is retrieving their details.
steps.text: धन्यवाद। मैं details check कर रहा हूँ।
steps.planner_rationale: Polite acknowledgment before making a tool call keeps the user informed.

steps.purpose: Lookup patient record using provided ID.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent should call lookup_patient_record to verify registration status.
steps.planner_rationale: Business rules require checking registration before proceeding with any booking or slot confirmation.

steps.purpose: Return patient record details.
Ask for identity verification factors.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent should ask for verification factors such as name or date of birth.
steps.text: आपका record मिल गया है। Security के लिए, क्या आप अपना registered नाम या date of birth बता सकते हैं?
steps.planner_rationale: Identity must be verified before performing consequential actions or disclosing detailed slot information.

steps.purpose: Provide name and date of birth for verification.
steps.text: मेरा नाम राहुल है। Date of birth 12 May है। मुझे meeting में जाना है, थोड़ा fast कीजिए।

steps.purpose: Verify customer identity using provided factors.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent should call verify_customer_identity with the offered factors.
steps.planner_rationale: The user provided verification factors which must be validated against the system.

steps.purpose: Return identity verification outcome.
Acknowledge verification and inform about checking slots.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent should acknowledge successful verification and state it is checking slots.
steps.text: Verification हो गया है। मैं next 3 days के लिए dermatology के slots check करता हूँ।
steps.planner_rationale: Transitioning smoothly to the next step keeps the user informed of the progress.

steps.purpose: Check doctor availability for 3 days.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent should call check_doctor_availability rather than book_appointment.
steps.planner_rationale: The user is asking for slots, so the agent must check availability first.

steps.purpose: Return empty slots for 3 days.
Inform user that no slots are available in 3 days.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent should state there are no slots, reflecting the empty array from the tool result.
steps.text: माफ़ कीजिए, next 3 days में dermatology के लिए कोई slot available नहीं है।
steps.planner_rationale: The tool returned an empty list, so the agent must inform the user without making up any slots.

steps.purpose: Express urgency and ask for other slots.
steps.text: ऐसे कैसे? मुझे urgently दिखाना है। क्या किसी और doctor का slot है?
steps.clean_text: ऐसे कैसे? मुझे urgently दिखाना है। क्या किसी और doctor का slot है?

steps.purpose: Offer to check for a wider window of 7 days.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent should offer to check for slots in the next available window (7 days).
steps.text: मैं next 7 days के लिए check कर लेता हूँ अगर आप चाहें तो।
steps.planner_rationale: Since the 3-day window is full, offering the next logical window helps progress the conversation.

steps.expected_behavior: The agent should confirm that no booking is being made and ask if anything else is needed.
steps.text: ठीक है, मैं कोई booking नहीं कर रहा हूँ। क्या मैं आपकी किसी और चीज़ में मदद कर सकता हूँ?
